title: Neon Brain in Crystal Sphere
description: A large transparent crystal sphere sits on a black pedestal in the center of a foggy cyberpunk street. Inside the sphere, a glowing brain-like structure with two swirling neon tendrils in yellow, pink, and purple rises from a textured stem, while vibrant paint drips heavily down the sphere's surface and from the top of the image.
prompt: A surreal cyberpunk scene featuring a massive transparent crystal sphere on a dark pedestal in the middle of a foggy futuristic city street at night. Inside the sphere is a glowing organic brain-like structure with two large swirling neon tendrils in yellow, pink, and purple, connected to a textured stem. Vibrant neon paint in pink, yellow, green, and purple drips heavily down the surface of the sphere and from the top of the frame. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
